title: Annotatio III §.VI close: Walden / Uspergensis / Ussher / Dunelm on Berengar; stop before §.VII (public monster / Lateran name)
pass_a_gloss: Thomas Netter of Walden alleges the Formula of Recantation, Tom. 2 ch. 24, and the Abbot of Ursperg in the Chronicle at the year 1080; but unroll the whole history of Berengar, reduced to a summary from the most learned Ussher’s book on the succession of the Churches ch. 7 from §28 to the end of the chapter, in the most elaborate History of Transsubstantiation already praised above of John of Durham ch. 7 §. 4 and following from p. 134 to p. 143.
pass_b_english: Recantation formula: Thomas Walden Tom. 2 ch. 24; Abbot of Ursperg Chronicle at 1080.
Full Berengar history: Ussher De successione Ecclesiarum ch. 7 §§28–end, summarized in John of Durham’s Historia Transsubstantiationis ch. 7 §.4 ff. pp. 134–143.
Stop before §.VII (public monster seated by papal decrees / Lateran name).
source_text: Formulam Recantationis affert Thom. Waldensis, Tom. 2. cap. 24. & Abbas Uspergensis in Chronico ad annum 1080; Integram verò de Berengario historiam, ex doctissimi Usserii libro de successione Ecclesiarum cap. 7. à parag. 28. ad fin. capitis, in summam redactam evolve, in elaboratissima Historia Transsubstantiationis jam suprà commendati Johannis Dunelmensis cap. 7. §. 4. & seqq. à p. m. 134. ad pag. 143.
